about.title: Building reliable software for real businesses
about.body: Frontend Developer with 2+ years of experience building enterprise logistics and B2B SaaS applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Passionate about building fast, scalable, and user-friendly web applications. Skilled in building reusable UI components, high-performance data grids, and large dynamic forms, while working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver maintainable software.

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: Where I've worked and what I've shipped.

tms-container.title: Apollogix TMS Container
tms-container.subtitle: Enterprise Transport Management System
achievements: Designed a transportation timeline view that displayed daily trips with minute-level accuracy, helping operators track drivers, containers, vehicles, routes, and idle time in one screen.
Built the timeline using AG Grid features such as pinned columns, custom cell renderers, column groups, column spans, and value getters.
Developed transport job forms with 50+ dynamic fields using React Hook Form and Yup.
Implemented AG Grid tables handling more than 15,000 routing records with infinite scrolling, server-side filtering, pagination, and Excel export.
Managed server state with TanStack Query using caching, query persistence, infinite queries, and mutation invalidation.

fms.title: Apollogix FMS
fms.subtitle: Freight Forwarding & Cost Control Platform
achievements: Developed logistics features used by more than 200 internal users and handling over 15,000 freight charge records.
Improved page responsiveness by reducing unnecessary re-renders and optimizing data fetching.
Built shipment and consolidation forms with 70+ fields and complex validation logic.
Developed editable AG Grid tables for large-scale logistics operations.

workspace.title: Apollogix Workspace
workspace.subtitle: B2B Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform
achievements: Built the frontend platform from project setup to production using Next.js.
Implemented multi-tenant authentication, workspace management, and vendor management.
Configured Docker and GitHub Actions for deployment and release workflows.
